The '''Kesh sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was spinward of the [[Ottega sector/Legends|Ottega sector]]. Planets in the sector included [[Ebra]].
